id: title:Gilbert09:implement the lexware office import source

review.reason: The change introduces Lexware Office as a warehouse ingestion option, including its metadata, API key configuration, and wiring into the warehouse ingestion system. It also removes the deprecated SimpleSource and replaces it with a ResumableSource, indicating a move toward resumable ingestion.
